design: Two color-swapped games from the same configured opening. Both sides use the same deterministic depth-1 material+PST engine (weak_engine.py); it leaves tactical mistakes a selector could avoid. The selector (Jev or seeded uniform random) picks among the top-3 root moves within margin of the best, in the weak engine's own units. No scores/ranks/base sent to Jev. Jev adds API time.
